meta.name: service-mesh-observability
meta.description: Implement comprehensive observability for service meshes including distributed tracing, metrics, and visualization. Use when setting up mesh monitoring, debugging latency issues, or implementing SLOs for service communication.

copy.tagline: 监控服务网格的分布式追踪与指标,快速定位延迟问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在运行微服务架构,想看清服务间的调用链和延迟瓶颈。
copy.tagline_en: Monitor service mesh traces and metrics to fix latency issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run microservices and need clear visibility into service-to-service latency.

howto.what: Claude 会按需给出 Istio、Linkerd 等服务网格的可观测性做法：指标、分布式追踪与日志的搭建，延迟和错误排查，以及服务通信 SLO 的定义；具体模板在 references/details.md。
howto.when: 当你要搭建服务网格监控、排查延迟或错误问题、定义服务通信 SLO，或配置分布式追踪与仪表盘时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 Istio 网格加上分布式追踪。
say.note: 按指南配置 trace 上下文传播

say.text: 服务间调用的 P99 延迟很高，怎么排查？
say.note: 对照黄金信号定位瓶颈

say.text: 帮我为服务通信定义 SLO 和告警阈值。
say.note: 使用延迟/错误/流量/饱和度阈值

howto.what_en: Claude then walks through mesh observability for Istio and Linkerd: metrics, distributed tracing, logs, latency and error troubleshooting, and SLOs for service communication. Templates are in references/details.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers when setting up mesh monitoring, debugging latency or error issues, defining SLOs for service communication, or working on distributed tracing and dashboards.

say_en.text: Add distributed tracing to my Istio mesh.
P99 latency between my services is high — help me debug it.
say_en.note: Uses golden signals to find bottlenecks

say_en.text: Define SLOs and alert thresholds for service communication.
say_en.note: Sets latency, error and saturation thresholds
